epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease pagination-related search abandonment from >15% to <2%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Frontend rendering bottleneck during large material search results
requirements: R1: Material search frontend must implement pagination logic and UI controls to paginate through large search result sets

slices.title: Implement pagination in MaterialSearch.svelte
slices.jtbd: When implementing pagination for this epic, I want to add pagination logic and controls to MaterialSearch.svelte, so that the material search results do not overwhelm the browser.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search result with many materials,
When I look at the UI,
Then I should see pagination controls to navigate through pages.
Given a user clicks to navigate to a new page of results,
When the new page is loading,
Then a visible loading indicator or progress state is shown so the user is not left guessing.
Given the newly added pagination controls,
When I interact with them,
Then they must satisfy WCAG 2.1 level AA standards, including keyboard operability, visible focus, labelled form controls, and 4.5:1 text contrast.
Given a frontend component change,
When I run the frontend vitest tests,
Then the tests verify that pagination logic correctly updates the displayed page state and renders the UI accordingly.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Memory leak/DOM overload rendering excessive MaterialSearch nodes
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease average material search UI render time for large result sets from >2000ms to <200ms
